from cyhole.jupiter import Jupiter
from cyhole.jupiter.client import GetSwapOrderParams, PostSwapExecuteBody

# Initialize Jupiter client (lite tier doesn't require an API key)
jupiter = Jupiter()

# SOL mint address
SOL_MINT = "So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112"
# USDC mint address  
USDC_MINT = "EPjFWaLb3odcccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc"

# Amount to swap (1 SOL = 1,000,000,000 lamports)
amount_in_lamports = 1_000_000_000

# Step 1: Request a swap quote (order)
swap_params = GetSwapOrderParams(
    input_mint=SOL_MINT,
    output_mint=USDC_MINT,
    amount=amount_in_lamports
)

print("Requesting swap quote...")
quote_response = jupiter.client.get_swap_order(swap_params)
print(f"Quote received: {quote_response.out_amount} USDC for {amount_in_lamports} lamports SOL")

# Step 2: Execute the swap
execute_body = PostSwapExecuteBody(
    route_plan=quote_response.route_plan,
    input_mint=SOL_MINT,
    output_mint=USDC_MINT,
    amount=amount_in_lamports,
    slippage_bps=300  # 3% slippage
)

print("Executing swap...")
execute_response = jupiter.client.post_swap_execute(execute_body)
print(f"Swap executed! Transaction: {execute_response.tx_base64}")
